title: Zoot's yearly phone calls
summary: Zoot calls him drunk and tearful, and an album on soprano never happens.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: Had Zoot done anything like that later?
Not that I know of. He's made some albums. He had called me a couple of times--I get calls from Zoot about once a year, he gets drunk and maudlin and he calls me up,
'George Handy, you're a fucking genius,' and he'll get tearful.
The last time he called he wanted to do an album with me on the soprano--he said I'm playing soprano now. As a matter of fact, I met him, he gave me the album he made on soprano. Have you heard it?

He said write me an album like you did on those altos, I said sure Zoot, I'll be glad to, set it up. Yeah, well, I have to get in touch with Norman Granz to set it up. I said you do that and get back to me, I'll be happy to do it. Then I hung up and I told Elaine he's not going to call back, he's just very mellow tonight and that's what came out.
And that's what came out of it, yeah.
